notes.title: Harem of Valerius Development Update: New Steps in Episode 3!
notes.notes:
I'm back with new updates! Here are the latest developments:

🎭 Character Updates
Elpis and Thetis are now in the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639554/b6a42423d5557c0b92e7f7340fb6903678d17196.png[/img]
Their models and special outfits have been successfully added.

The characters now fully blend into the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639554/ffc95687501acd22e5f15accd34fd136ec56af8c.png[/img]

💃 Brothel Mechanics Improvements
Bugs in cutscenes have been fixed.

Romance sequences are now smoother and more seamless.
Note : I will fix the hair shaders

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639554/3cd16e2b23baef90de1e07d67a3fa231e47080f7.png[/img]


🏙️ Revitalized City Atmosphere
New NPC animations have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639554/9efcd7c73437d874463d7f0f94f585369db4ab14.png[/img]

The streets now feel more dynamic and alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639554/054d7102cfcb791185b69f8fd6ad8b5e07cd6aa7.png[/img]



🔮 Next Goal: Thetis' Ship & City Management
After completing Thetis' quest:

New city mechanics will be introduced.

Randomized quests will unlock through Thetis' ship.

Manage the ship to gather resources and strengthen your city.

If you show her enough attention, surprise rewards await you! 😊

Please don't forget to add your wishlist ; https://store.steampowered.com/app/3714590/Harem_Of_Valerius

Thank you
